tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i chog mngon dga'i zhing gi rgyan mdzes byed lhan thabs in+d+ra nī la'i chun 'phyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang mgon po mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// stobs bcu'i dbang phyug khyod mtshan dran ma thag /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dkrugs pa dang*// lhan cig byang chub lam las phyir mi ldog /mthong thos don dang ldan la phyag 'tshal lo// mun khung la ni sgron me bzhin// las sgrib mtshan tsam gyis sel ba// gang de'i gzungs mdo rgya gzhung gi /gsal byed gzhan la phan phyir 'bri// de'ang gar dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs 'di ni rtsa ba'i rgya gzhung dang jo bo chen po'i dgongs par 'byor nges pa'i tshig nyung don zab yid ches pa'i gnas su snang zhing*/ spyir jo bo lugs kyi mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu 'di jo nang rje btsun chen pos bya rgyud spyod rgyud du bkral bar bzhed pa'i rjes su phyi ma rnams 'brangs mod/ spyod rgyud rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i dbang dang lam rim sbyor du med pas/ nang gi ting nge 'dzin tsam las dbang dang yan lag lhag ma bya rgyud ltar sbyor zhing*/ bya rgyud dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i rigs la bya ba'ang bsdus pa mdzad pa brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes su 'byung ba nyid sor bzhag ste gsal byed lhan thabs 'god pa la gsum/ rang don bsnyen sgrub kyi zin bris/ gnyis don sbyin sreg gi lag len/ gzhan don phan gdags pa'i rim pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ 'jug pa'i spyod pa/ sbyor ba'i spyod pa/ sgrub pa'i spyod pa/ grub pa'i spyod pa'o// dang po ni/ bsnyen pa sogs kyis dag par byas pa'i bla ma yon tan dang ldan pa las/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum gyi ya gyal de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang 'khor bcas nod la/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i dam tshig chen po bzhir grags pa/ 'jig rten pa'i yang dag lta ba/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/

byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba rnams dang*/ bya rgyud spyi'i dam tshig bcu bzhi/ rang rigs khyad par gyi spang blang la brtson pa ste/ mdor na dbang dang dam tshig legs par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas bsnyen sgrub la 'jug dgos pa ni/ lo tog bskyed 'dod pas zhing sa dang sa bon drod gsher 'dzom dgos pa bzhin no// gnyis pa sbyor ba'i spyod pa ni bsnyen pa dngos te/ de la gnyis/ yan lag dang*/ gtso bo'o// dang po ni/ dpung bzang las yan lag bcu dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bsnyen pa bya bar gsungs pa de rnams dngos grub nges par sgrub pa'i dbang du mdzad cing*/ dkyus 'gre tsam la gtso bor bsngags pa gnas dus sogs tshogs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gnas khang byi dor dang rnam 'joms bzlas pa'i gzungs chus gtsang bar byas pa'i ku sha 'og tu bkram pa'i mal legs par 'chos pa sogs bsnyen sgrub spyi ltar mkho ba'i yo byad sta gon bya/ mdun gyi stegs bur ring bsrel dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rten/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i ras bris yod na bkram pa'i spyan sngar kha zas dkar gsum bzang dgu las bcos pa'i zlum gtor pad 'dab bzhi pa/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ maṇ+ḍal gyi yo byad/ cha gsum dang gzhi bdag gtor ma bsham/ rang gi mdun tu las bum mam/ dung zhal gyi chur dri bzang sbyar ba gang bde rgyun tu nye reg la spyod bde bar bzhag /gzhan yang a mṛ tas bsngags pa'i mar dkar dang spra rtsi lus la bdug pas mtshon bya rgyud kyi gegs sel rdzas kyang chags med ri chos las 'byung ba ltar snga tshag bya zhing*/ skabs su spyad par bya'o// gza' skar tshes dus bzang por bsnyen pa la 'jug pa'i snga nyin gyi snga dror mgo lus legs par bkru/ dri zhim po'i spos kyis bdug /ba byung dang sbyar ba'i dri chab la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te uṣ+ḍi ṣā ya/ oṃ bi shud+dhe bī ra dze shī ba shā na ti ka re swā hā/

zhes pa'i sngags 'di brgya rtsa sogs ci 'grub bzlas la kha bshal zhing khong du btung bas zla phyed phan chad kyi sha sogs bza' min zos pa'i nyes pa byang bar gsungs/ de nas phyag bskor maṇ+ḍal/ gser 'od las 'byung ba'i bshags pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yig brgya bzla ba sogs ci 'grub bya/ legs grub las/ rgyal ba'i rigs la bo dhe tse// sngags kyi nor bu rab tu bsgrags// zhes pa ltar/ bo dhi tse'i bgrang phreng ba byung gis bkrus la spos kyis bdug /lung thag kyang grub na ko thig ma yin pa ras bal gyi skud pa la brgyu dgos pa yin no// phyi dror rang nyid lhag pa'i lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gzhi bdag spyi gtor gang bde dang*/ cha gsum gtor ma byin rlabs nas brtsams kun rig ltar bsngos/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring thung sogs drag sngags gu gul dud pa yungs thun bcas pas bgegs bskrad la srung 'khor spyi mthun tsam bsgom/ sgo rtsar tho dkar po 'dzugs pa la phyag rdor dang rgyal chen bzhi'i sngags byang gzug /de nas brtsams te bsnyen pa grub kyi bar dmigs 'og tu ma chud pa'i rgyu 'grul dang yo byad sogs zhud srung zhing*/ gtsang sbra'i kun spyod sogs dam tshig la lhag par gnas par bya'o// gnyis pa sbyor spyod gtso bo la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ bsnyen pa la 'jug pa'i nyin dang po'i nangs mor yang sgrub pa pos yan lag lnga khrus dang*/ spos dkar gyis bdug /gos gtsang ma gyon/ byang mchis ma lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong don zhags lugs ltar rab dus rgyun/ 'bring nya stong brgyad/ tha na nyin dang po tsam la len nus na rab byung phyogs la'ang theg chen sdom pa gso ba'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa yin pas gso sbyong lan gsum blangs la tshul khrims rnam dag gi gzungs nyer gcig brjod/ 'di blangs phyin yan lag brgyad gtsang mar bsrung dgos pas phyi dro'i kha zas kyang nges par spang*/

de nas sgrub khang gi khyam mam sdod gnas las gzhan pa zhig tu 'dug la/ khrus chab dang*/ sa gtsang ma theb gang mdun tu bzhag /lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe'u chung gshibs te bsgrengs/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse sbyar te brkyang ba'i g.yas g.yon tu mthe bong gnyis sbyar ba khro bo mnol ba med pa'i phyag rgya de/ snying ga dang*/ lkog ma dang*/ smin mtshams dang*/ spyi bo rnams su sngags lan re res gtugs/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ha na da ha pa tsa/ bi dhā na sa ya/ u tsuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bzhi/ rdor bsdams las mdzub mo gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs/ mthe bong gnyis de'i g.yas g.yon tu sbyar la/ oṃ ni kha na ba su dhe swā hā/ lan bdun la sogs pa mang du bzlas te/ sa dang chus bkrus par bsam/ de nas khrus kyis srung ba ni/ mthe bos mthe chung gi sen mo mnan/ sor mo lhag ma gsum rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i tshul du byas/ lag gnyis bsnol nas phyag rgya de dpung pa g.yas g.yon tu bzhag la/ yid tsam aṃ gtsigs bsdams/ khro bo'i lta ba dang bcas pas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ ma hā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags rgyas bdag nyid srung ngo*// de nas bsangs chu sgrub pa ni/ snod bzang por chu gtsang ma dri zhim pos sbags pa la dmigs te/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ oṃ hūm̐ ha na ha na badz+re badz+re ṇa haḥbargya rtsa tsam bzlas/ g.yon pa rdo rje rtse gsum gyi rgya gong du smos pas bsangs chu blangs te/ oṃ ki li ki li badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan bdun bzla zhing*/ bdag dang*/ gnas dang*/ yo byad dang*/ sa'i gong bu la bsangs gtor bya/ de nas sa byin gyis brlabs ni/ oṃ badz+ra ha ra hūm̐/ lan bdun brjod/ oṃ bhu ra dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun las mi nyung ba bzlas te/

lag pa las sa byug cing 'phyid par bya/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan nyer gcig tsam yid kyis bzla zhing*/ lus dang gdong dang lag pa rnams khrus chus bkru'o// de nas khang par zhugs/ lha rnams mngon sum du dmigs pa la phyag byas nas/ sgo nang du lho la phyogs te 'dug la/ gnas su zhugs shing dam tshig la 'jug pa'i sngags/ oṃ bi ra dza bi ra dza ma hā badz+rī sa ta sa ta sā ra te sā ra te tra ye tra ye/ bi dha ma ni sam bhañdza ni ta ra ma ti sid+dha a gre tam swā hā/ lan gsum brjod la 'grengs bzhin tu/ bdag srung ba ni/ oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ ban+dha swā hā/ zhes pa de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi las thams cad pa lan nyer gcig dang*/ na mo rat+na sogs bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags 'bring po lan gsum gyis dung chos la sogs pa bsang chu'i snod lag pa g.yon tu bzhag /g.yas pas rang gi lus la gtor/ sngags de lan gsum bzla bzhin tu/ mchod pa la 'thor yab kyis bsangs chu gtor/ yang dzi na dzik ces pa de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi snying po lan bdun las mi nyung bas kyang mchod pa la bsangs gtor bya/ de nas lag g.yon pa'i gung srin mthe bos mnan/ mdzub mo dang mthe'u chung gnyis gdu bu'i tshul du gung srin gnyis kyi rgyab tu sbyar/ g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya kha gyen tu bstan nas g.yon gyis theb mdzub gi 'og nas bton te/ gung mo bzung ba ltar byed pa ni/ gzi byin bskyed pa'i phyag rgya ste/ de nyid mchod pa rnams kyi steng nas/ lding skor dang bram pa ste cab cab reg pa'i tshul dang thigs gtor gyi tshul byed la/ oṃ te dza te dza saṃ sid+dhi sā dha ya swā hā/ lan mang du bzlas la mchod pa'i gzi byin bskyed/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags 'bring po phyag rgya bcas gong bzhin lan gsum mam bdun sogs kyis mchod pa byin rlabs/ dzi na dzik lan gsum la sogs pas brtan par bya/ de nas lag pa gnyis ka'i gung srin gnyis gdu bu ltar byas te/

rang rang phyogs kyi sbe sha la btsugs/ mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo gshibs te bsgrengs/ mthe bong rtse sbyar te bsgreng ba las lag mgo'i rgyab nang du phyogs pas rtse mo 'thur la bstan pa ni phur bu'i phyag rgya ste/ oṃ kī li kā la badz+ri badz+re bhur bhan+da hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum bzlas pas bgegs thams cad la phur bus btab par bsam/ oṃ ki li kī la badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa kyis kyang bsangs gtor bya/ rdo rje'i rwa gur sra zhing mthug la rtse mo mthon por grub par mos/ oṃ kī li kī la badz+ri badz+re bhu ra ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa kyis sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum gyis bsrung 'khor rnams byin gyis brlabs par mos shing*/ mthe bos sor mo rnams mnan pa'i khu tshur bcings la/ sdig mdzub brkyang ste/ dbus nas rgya je che je cher lan gsum du bskor zhing*/ na maḥs man+ta badz+ra ṇāṃ/ oṃ ta ra ta ra tu ru tu ru ma ṭa ma ṭa ban+dha ban+dha/ sarba tra a pra ti ha ra sa sa me sa mān+ta ku ru ku ru/ ta ra ta ra/ sa man+ta badz+re sa man+ta badz+re ku ru a ma le ku ru ṇa ma ye/ tu ta ye tu ta ye/ ba ra ba ra ka ra ka ra su me ma sa man+ta bi dhā na sa ya dz+wa la ya swā hā/ lan gsum/ rdo rje'i rwa ba'i phyi rol du me dpung 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ slar yang spos chu lag mthil du blugs la/ dzi na dzika mang du bzlas te/ rang gi spyi bo nas bsangs gtor bya/ rtswa ku sha'i gdan sogs la 'dug par mos te/ na mo rat+na nas/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa gyi bar bdud rtsi thab sbyor bzla bzhin tu/ snyan la bsangs gtor byas te/ skyil mo krung gis 'dug go /de nas/ bdag gis sems can sogs byang chub kyi sems sngon tu 'gro ba'i bsod nams tshogs bsags ni/ rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can tu gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phros pas/ bla ma mi bskyod pa longs sku'i rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan pa'i mi 'khrugs pa rigs lnga rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor ba spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa la/

rang nyid tha mal pa'i lus grangs med pa sprul te phyag 'tshal bar mos la sngags brjod/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las sprul pa'i lha mo nyer spyod lnga dang*/ bkra shis rdzas rtags 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rin chen rnam bdun sogs mchod pa nam mkha' gang bas mchod par mos la sngags rgyas mchod/ sdig pa bshags pa sogs yan lag lhag ma don dran bzhin pas lan gsum brjod la/ sngags rgyas tshogs zhing chos kyi dbyings su gshegs la tshad med pa bzhi spyi ltar bsgom/ de nas shū n+ya tā'i sngags brjod cing*/ stong pa nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid nga'o zhes pa'i sngags don dran pa ni ye shes tshogs bsags te sbyor ba'i chos grub bo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi/ bdag gi de kho na nyid/ lha'i de kho na nyid/ bzlas pa'i de kho na nyid/ bsam gtan gyi de kho na nyid do// dang po ni/ chos rnams thams cad sogs rkang pa gnyis te/ khams gsum po ni sems tsam/ sems de'ang dmigs pa med pa nam mkha' lta bu/ thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni/ gzung 'dzin la sogs pa'i rtog pa med pa/ rnam par rtog pa'i snang ba med pa/ rdul phra rab kyi gzugs dngos po med pa/ mtshan ma'i g.yo ba med pa/ de rnams kyis stong pa'i med dgag las kyang 'das pa 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin/ ngo bo so sor rang gis rig pa ste mtshan nyid drug ldan gyi gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po spros pa dang bral pa'i ye shes kun 'gro kun la khyab pa'o snyam du yun ring mnyam par bzhag go /gnyis pa lha'i de kho na nyid la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ de sgrub pa'i yan lag go /dang po la drug /stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dang*// phyag rgya mtshan ma drug yin te// zhes pa ltar las dang po stong pa'i lha ni/ bdag gi de kho na nyid spros bral 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin yin pa ltar lha'i de kho na nyid kyang de ltar yin pas de gnyis dbyer med don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo stong pa nyid la mnyam par 'jog go

/gnyis pa yi ge'i lha ni/ de yi ngang las sogs rkang pa lnga ste/ stong nyid de'i ngang las dmigs med snying rje'i rang rtsal rang sems zla bar snang ba la hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer 'bar bas mtshan par bsam/ gsum pa sgra'i lha ni/ hūm̐ de las sngags kyi rang sgra si li li sgrog par bsam/ bzhi pa phyag rgya'i lha ni/ hūm̐ de rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur pa mos/ de las 'od 'phros sogs rkang pa drug gi don dran bzhin tu gshegs rigs kyi dam rgya thal mo bkan pa'i mdzub mo gnyis cung zad nang du bkug pa bcas la sngags brjod/ gzhung las rdo rje rigs kyi dam rgya 'cha' bar bshad pa ni sngags dang 'gal bas brtag par bya'o// lnga pa gzugs kyi lha ni/ de dag yongs su gyur pa sogs sh+lo ka phyed gsum gyis bdag nyid mi 'khrugs pa sprul sku chags bral gyi rnam pa gzugs yongs su rdzogs par bsgom pa'o// drug pa mtshan ma'i lha ni 'og nas 'byung*/ 'di rnams rgyud sde gzhan gyi mngon byang lnga la sogs pa'i dod yin no// gnyis pa yan lag ni/ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla la hūm̐ sngon po 'od zer 'phro ba gsal btab/ 'di'ang don du phyag rgya'i lhar 'du'o// de'i 'od zer gyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ bum pa'i chu blugs shing*/ cod pan spyi bor bzhag pas dbang bskur/ dbang rtags su gnas gsum du zla ba la gnas pa'i 'bru gsum gyis mtshan par gyur/ slar yang thugs srog 'od kyis mngon dga'i zhing nas mi 'khrugs ye shes pa spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la tshogs zhing skabs ltar sprul pa'i lha mos mchod/ rgya bzhis rang dam tshig pa la bstims pas thugs kar pad zla la/ dbus su ye shes sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pa rang dang 'dra ba de'i phyogs bzhir sangs rgyas rigs bzhi sprul sku'i rnam pa/ gtso bo ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar pad zla la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ sngon po baiḍūr+ya mdog lta bu/

'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba'i mthar bzla bya'i gzungs sngags yig ngo nang bstan g.yas bskor du sbrul 'khyil ba'i tshul gyis mi g.yo bar gnas pa gsal gdab/ thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas rang la mchod cing bstod par mos la/ mchod bstod ngag tu 'don/ mthar lha mo rnams rang la bsdu/ de nas rang lhar gsal ba la rtse gcig tu sems bzung nas srol rtsol bsdams te ji srid gsal snang thob pa'am/ mi skyo'i bar du mnyam par bzhag /gal te de las ldang bar 'dod na rjes shes thams cad du lha de'i rnam pa yang nas yang du dran cing snod bcud kyi snang ba thams cad dag snang du bltas la rang gi lha'i gnas lus longs spyod du bsgom pa ni mtshan ma'i lha'o// gsum pa bzlas pa'i de kho na nyid ni/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/ sgra dang sems dang gzhi la gzhol// gsang sngags mi 'gyur gzhi la gnas// yan lag ma nyams gsang sngags bzlas// ngal na bdag la ngal sos shig /ces pas yan lag gsum gyis bzlas pa'i gzhi 'dzin pa/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i bzlas pa khyad par du dbye ba/ bzlas pa'i skyon spangs zhing grangs kyi tshul/ dub pa ngal gso ba dang bzhi/ zhar byung bslab bya'i gnas dang phan yon bstan pa bcas lnga'o// dang po yan lag gsum ni/ gzhi dang sems dang sgra ste gsum yod/ gzhi la'ang rnam snang mngon byang gi dgongs pas gnyis kyi gzhi dang po rang sems bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po gdod ma'i sangs rgyas rang chos su bzhugs par shes pa/ gzhi gnyis pa ni de nyid gzugs sku'i rnam par shar ba rang nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar/ sems kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ sgra hūm̐ yig sngags phreng sgra gdangs can tu gsal/ 'di gnyis la rnam snang mngon byang du yi ge dang po dang gnyis pa'i tha snyad mdzad/ de nas bgrang phreng rab gnas sngags lan gsum brjod/

thog mar lag pa g.yas pa'i gung mo dang mthe'u chung brkyang*/ mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab tu bkug cing sbyar/ mthe bos srin lag gi steng nas snying ga'i thad du bgrang dgos la/ rim par ngal na lag pa g.yon pas spyi ltar du bgrang*/ yul la 'phro ba'i kun rtog thams cad spang ste lha sngags sgra dang bcas pa la dran 'dun rgyun mi 'chad pa yang dang yang du dran pa rtse gcig pa'i sems kyis mngon sum dang 'dra bar bltas la skyon rnams spangs pa'i bzlas pa la gzhol/ dmigs pa brtan pa na/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas/ sems cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer slar 'dus te rang la thim pas bdag nyid kyi tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par bsam/ 'dir sngags ngo nang du bstan pa ni rgyud sde rnams spyir btang yin cing 'phags bod mkhas grub spyi'i bzhed par ma zad/ bo dong 'jigs bral chen po sogs kyis yang yang dmigs su bshad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba yin la/ lugs 'dir sngags phreng 'khor rgyu med cing*/ gzhung du sngags phreng 'khor bar bshad pa ltar na sngags ngo'ang phyir bstan dgos la 'di ni grub chen karma pa'i gdams ngag rnying lugs dang bsre 'dres mdzad pa'i kaṃ tshang lugs spyi'i dbang du mdzad par mngon pas/ 'dir ni gong smos ltar rgyud sde rang lugs dang chos 'di gang las brgyud pa'i khungs bu lugs sogs dang mthun na legs par sems so// yang*/ bo dong kun mkhyen 'jigs med zhabs kyis rgyud sde spyi rnam bya rgyud skabs su bzlas pa la stong pa'i bzlas pa sogs lha drug dang sbyor bar mdzad cing*/ gzugs kyi bzlas pa spro bsdu la sbyor te/ zla ba sngags dang bcas pa las 'od zer sna tshogs pa 'phros pa'i rtse mo las rang gi lha'i gzugs/

sku'i sprin mtha' yas pas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab/ 'phags pa thams cad mchod pa'i sprin gyis dgyes par byas shing sems can thams cad sngags kyi 'od zer gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis sdug bsngal zhi bar byas nas/ lha'i sku 'od zer dang bcas pa rnal 'byor pa rang gi gnas gsum du thim pa yang rtse gcig tu bsam zhes gsungs pa slob dpon byang chub mchog gi dgongs par yang snang bas skabs su dmigs pa'i rtsal sbyong bya ste/ 'di dag gi skabs su thog mar sgra bcas dang rim par shub bu'i bzlas pa gong bas thos tsam du bya'o// gnyis pa dngos grub sgrub pa'i bzlas pa ni/ gtso bor mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba yin kyang bdag bskyed la'ang sbyor ba mdzad pas de ltar na/ thog mar ngag bzlas grangs bsnyen tsam song nas 'di nyid gtsor bya ba ste/ dmigs pa'i gzhi sngar ltar la/ srog rtsol bsdams nas zla ba sngags phreng la sems rtse gcig tu bzhag ste yid bzlas bya/ rlung gtong ba na rang nyid gong smos ltar gzhi gnyis kyi nga rgyal bzung ba la yang yang bslab pa'o// gsum pa skyon spang grangs tshad dang bcas pa ni/ dpung bzang las/ bzlas brjod byed tshe mi myur mi dal zhing*// sgra cher mi bya ha cang chung ba min// smra bzhin ma yin gzhan tu g.yengs bzhin min// gug skyed klad kor tsheg drag nyams pas min// gug skyed yi ge lhag chad gyur pa yis// gsang sngags dngos grub rgya chen mi ster ro// zhes dang*/ gug skyed klad kor tsheg tshang zur phyin la// gsang sngags dag cing shin tu cho gar bcas// sangs rgyas byang chub sems pas bstan pa yi// gnas su bzlas na yid 'ong dngos grub 'thob// ces gsungs pa ltar yan lag ma nyams par bzla dgos so// bzlas pa'i tshad ni/ dngos grub sgrub pa la tshad med de ma 'grub kyi bar du bskyar nas bsgrub dgos la/ grangs bsnyen tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ legs grub las yig 'bru bco lnga man chad la/

'bru 'bum/ sum cu rtsa gnyis man chad la sum 'bum/ de yan chad la khri bzla bar gsungs pa 'di la bo dong chen po sogs bshad tshul 'dra min 'ga' re snang ba las/ deng sang lag len tu sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud las gsungs pa'i gzungs ring 'di'i dbang du byas nas/ rab 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa/ tha ma 'bum phrag gcig kha skong bcas kyis bsnyen pa dang*/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa la khri tsam gyis 'grub pa'i rtsis su mdzad do// bzhi pa ngal gso ba ni/ ngag bzlas dang yid bzlas la sogs pas skyo zhing dub pa'i skabs su ting nge 'dzin btang nas yul la g.yeng ba mi bya bar bdag gi de kho na nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag ste ngal gso zhing thun mtshams la 'jug par bshad do// lnga pa bslab bya phan yon dang bcas pa ni/ bsnyen sgrub la zhugs nas mthar ma son gyi bar du rab dkar gsum la brten pa'i gdan gcig /tha ma gdan gnyis pa zhes snga dro dang nyin gung la lan gnyis za zhi phyi dro kha zas spang bar bshad pas nus na legs/ gang ltar yang sha chang sgog btsong la phug rang gi kham 'phro za ba rnams spang*/ 'khar ba'i snod lo ma lag mthil rnams su mi bza'/ bzlas pa la zhugs nas thun mtshams la ma sleb bar bza' btung gshang gci 'dor ba langs 'dug sogs spang*/ bzlas pa'i grangs stan thog gcig tu song ba dang*/ lha gzhan gyi sgom bzlas dang ma 'dres pa dang*/ bzlas pa la zhugs nas smra bcad dang*/ nyal ba dang bsnyes pa la sogs pas lus mi 'gyur ba dang*/ rtog pa 'og 'gyu dang bral ba dang*/ lha la gsol ba gdab pa'i tshul gyis sus par bzla ba/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pa dang*/ sngags kyi nor bu zhes pa phreng rdog yin pas mdo 'dzin rdzogs pa phreng skor cig zlos kyi bar du sbrid pa dang*/ lud pa dang*/ thur sel gyi rlung sogs byung na de'i phreng skor bor nas nye reg byas te yid kyis phyag byas nas/

slar yang mdo 'dzin nas brtsams te bzlas pa dag grangs su bgrang bar bya la/ mdo 'dzin par ma rdzogs pa'i bzlas pa bsags pas kyang grangs kyi go mi chod cing*/ bzlas pa'i bar du bgegs kyis rloms pa dang*/ nad kyis gzir pa sogs byung na grangs kyi bzlas par mi sbyar ba sogs kyi blang dor bya ba gal che'o// gal te stan thog gcig tu bzlas pa ma rdzogs pa glo bur du 'gro dgos pa sogs byung nas slar bsnyen pa rdzogs par 'dod na/ gzhi nas bskyar thub na legs/ ma thub na bsnyen tshad kyi steng du 'bum phrag phyed lhag por bzlas pas go chod par bshad de/ legs grub las/ gnas gcig tu ni phyed bzlas nas// gang zhig gzhan la bzlas byas pa// bzlas pa

yang gzhan tu bzlas pas thams cad rdzogs gyur kyang*// de dag thams cad don med 'gyur// de lta'i bsnyen pa stan thog gcig tu ma song na bsnyen tshad kyi steng du 'bum phrag phyed lhag por btang na go chod pas klag la cho ga bzhin// phyed 'bum lhag par bzlas brjod bya// bdag po stong du bzlas pa'am// yang na bsnyen pa slar brtsam mo// zhes gsungs so// bzlas pa'i phan yon spyir/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ tshe rabs gzhan tu gang dang gang byas pa'i// sdig pa ma lus bzlas brjod byas pas 'byang*// bzlas pas sdig pa ma lus byang gyur na// dang pa'i yid kyis dngos grub 'thob par 'gyur// der ni bcom ldan rgyal ba'i dbang po yis// chos 'di kun gyi rtsa ba sems zhes gsungs// sems ni dang bas lha mi'i bde ba dang*// mtho ris dang ni byang grol 'thob par 'gyur// sems kyi skyon gyis dud 'gror skye ba dang*// sems dmyal gnas shing mi sdug dbul gan 'gyur// sems ni rab tu dang bar gyur pa'i mis// sa chu me rlung skye rga 'chi la sogs// thog ma bar mthar gnod pa kun bral ba// rnam grol bde zhing zhi ba 'thob par 'gyur// gsang sngags dngos grub kun dang thun mong ba// bde ba chung zhing sdug bsngal brgya dang 'bral// nyon mongs dug bcas rnam par 'jigs 'gyur ba// dang ba'i sems kyis 'thob par 'gyur ba yin// zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ khyad par las sgrib sbyong ba'i gzungs nyid kyi phan yon ni gzhung du gsal ba ltar ro// bzhi pa bsam gtan gyi de kho na nyid la gsum/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/ gsang sngags mo gnas dngos grub ster// sgra gnas rnal 'byor ster bar dran// sgra mthas thar pa ster ba nyid// 'di dag de nyid gsum po yin// zhes spyod rgyud kyi mtshan med ting nge 'dzin bod kyi slob dpon rnams kyis bya rgyud la sbyor ba mdzad pa ste/ dang po me gnas kyi de nyid ni/

rang nyid lhag pa'i lha'i gzhi'i yan lag yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs kar mar me'i lce 'dra ba'i me 'bar ba/ tsha reg med pa zhi ba'i nang du/ zla ba la gnas pa'i sngags kyi tshig gi yi ge'i 'bru gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rang bzhin can bsam pa la rtse gcig tu dmigs te/ srog bsdam pa'i sbyor bas gsal ma thob kyi bar du bslab/ 'di ni zhi sogs kyi las thams cad bsgrub pa'i gzhir gyur pa'o// gnyis pa sgra gnas kyi de nyid ni/ rang lha'i thugs kar zla ba la zhi ba'i me mar me'i lce lta bu'i dbus su gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba rab tu gsal bar bsgom/ cung zad tsam nas de'i rnam pa'ang mi dmigs par dril bu'i sgra lta bu'i rang byung gi sngags sgra'i dbyangs tsam grags pa 'ba' zhig bsams nas/ srog bsdam zhing rtse gcig tu dmigs pas gsal snang thob kyi bar du bslab/ 'di ni zhi gnas skye ba'i rten gzhir gyur pa'o// gsum pa sgra mtha'i de nyid ni/ sngags kyi sgra tsam de yang dpyad cing gzhig pas ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar shes nas bdag gi de kho na nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngang la mnyam par 'jog /'dis ni lhag mthong gi ye shes 'char zhing thar pa'i nyer len dngos nyid du 'gyur ro// spyir lha drug dang*/ bzlas brjod yan lag gsum/ bsam gtan gsum rnams snga ma snga ma la brtan pa thob nas phyi ma phyi mar 'jug cing gzhol dgos pa yin mod/ da lta grangs bsnyen tsam gyi skabs su'ang bzlas pa che longs tsam song nas thun mtha' rnams su gsum ka'am/ phyi ma gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'brel pa 'jog par bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis/ thun dang thun mtshams kyi bya ba'o// dang po thun grol zhing bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i mthar/ lag gnyis srin lag gi rgyab tu gung mo sbyar/ de gnyis g.yon pa'i mdun tu g.yas pa'i rgyab sbyar te bsnol/ g.yas kyi mdzub mo g.yon gyi gung srin dang*/

g.yon gyi mdzub mo g.yas kyi gung srin la 'khyud/ mthe bong gnyis mdzub mo'i tshigs dbus ma la bzhag /mthe'u chung gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba bum pa'i phyag rgya byas la bzlas brjod kyi ni sogs brjod la bzlas brjod kyi dge ba 'bul zhing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab ste phreng ba rten gyi spyan sngar bzhag /thugs ka'i rigs bzhi zla ba sngags phreng bcas gtso bo la bsdus te nam mkhar phyungs nas mchod bstod nongs bshags mthar rang la slar bstim/ ye shes pa rang gi lus las phyung nas de la mchod bstod gshigs gsol bya ba ni rgyud sde 'og ma'i bshad tshod ni yin mod/ bla med kyi nyams len can la de shin tu mi 'thad ces bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed bas bdag gi de kho na nyid la mnyam par bzhag /rang dam tshig pa'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum dang*/ khyad par mgo dang snying gar zla ba bh+rūm̐ yig gis mtshan pas bsrung bar bsams la/ dzi na dzika /lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa ni stan las ldangs ba na/ sems can thams cad kyi don bya ba'i spyod pa la 'jug go snyam du bsams la/ sgrub thabs ltar gtor ma 'bul/ mngon dga'i zhing gi smon lam sogs theg pa chen po'i smon lam bsam pa thag pa nas gdab/ sher phyin sogs theg pa chen po'i mdo sde gang rung khri'u gtsang ma la bkur bsti dang bcas pas bzhugs su gsol nas bklag dgos la/ cis kyang ma grub na de la phyag 'tshal ba tsam nges par dgos/ kha zas la 'jug pa na/ oṃ o ka dz+wā la badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ srung ba bya/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha bo dhi satwa nāṃ/ oṃ ba liṃ dad de te dzo mā li ni swā hā/ zhes lan brgyad kyis bsngags te/ kham dang po lhag pa'i lha la 'bul/ de nas zos te khrus bya'o// khrus byed pa na bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzla'o// nyal pa na stobs po che'i sngags kyis bsrungs la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/

phyag na rdo rje dang*/ shā ri'i bu rnams la phyag byas te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs dang*/ bla na med pa'i dngos grub kyi mchog stsol zhig /rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab la/ chos kyi 'du shes kyis nyal lo// de bzhin tu rjes dran drug dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ sāts+tsha 'debs pa dang*/ snod dag par byed pa dang*/ gos bgo ba'i sngags dang*/ dngos dang rmi lam du 'dzag pa srung sogs kyang bya spyod spyi ltar gang shes bya/ skabs skabs su gong smos bza' ba min pa'i nyes pa 'dag pa'i sngags bzla zhing ba'i rnam lnga btung ba sogs kyang bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis thun bzhi'am gsum re bcad cing bsnyen pa'i grangs rdzogs par byed dgos pa las/ thugs thun rjes ma rnams kyi 'gor/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring thung gis srung ba dang bsangs gtor bya/ mchod kha gso zhing gzi skyed byin rlabs brtan pa tsam byas te/ gzhung gi sems bskyed nas/ gtor 'bul smon lam gyi bar du 'gres su 'khor ro// bsnyen pa rdzogs pa na bsnyen pa ji tsam grub pa'i bcu cha zhi ba'i sreg blugs skabs 'dir nges par bya dgos shing*/ sbyin sreg cis kyang mi 'grub pa dag gis sāts+tsha grangs de tsam btab pas lhag chad kyi kha skong 'gyur ba yin no// gsum pa sgrub pa'i spyod pa ni/ dpung bzang las/ cho ga bzhin tu dang por 'bum bzlas nas// de nas gsang sngags sgrub la 'jug par bya// de las myur du dngos grub 'thob 'gyur la// gsang sngags cho gas yun ring nyon mi mongs// zhes gsungs pa ltar gong du brjod pa'i bsnyen pa'i yan lag ma tshang ba med pa rnams kyis lha bsten pas nye ba'i mtshan ma mthong ba na sgrub pa la 'jug ste/ de'i dgongs pa dngos ni ral gri mig sman sogs la brten nas 'dod gzugs kyi rig 'dzin bsgrubs nas phra yang sogs dbang phyug gi yon tan brgyad mngon tu byas te mkha' spyod du 'gro ba yin kyang*/

da lta mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa la dmigs nas sgrub pa'i sa bcad tsam ni/ bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ sa chog grub na kun rig ltar bya/ sgrub gnas rnying par ma grub kyang ha cang 'gal ba med pas sku rten gyi spyan sngar ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i dbus su bum pa dang*/ srung 'khor gzungs bsgril/ phur pa tshon skud gyi drwa ba/ mchod pa'i yo byad sogs gzhung las 'byung ba ltar bkod la thun re re bzhin bdag mdun bum pa'i bzlas pa grub mthar/ rjes kyi cho ga rnams phyag len bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i skabs su thun mong gi bzlas dmigs bsten pa dang mtshungs/ khyad par gyi bzlas pa'i skabs thog mar bzlas pa'i gzhi gsal thebs pa na/ srog bsdams pas mdun bskyed thugs ka nas zla ba sngags phreng dang bcas pa gnyis pa bkug ste byon/ rang gi snying ga'i zla ba sngags phreng la thim pas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs par gyur par mos la sems bzung*/ dbugs gtong ba na 'od zer spros te mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul bar mos nas mdun bskyed la sems gtad/ slar srog bsdams shing dmigs pa snga ma ltar bar ma chad par bya/ grub pa'i skabs 'dir khrus dang gtsang sbra mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga sogs rgyas la ma chags pa gnad che zhing*/ sgrub pa grub pa'i mjug brgyad dam bco lnga lta bu zhig la khel bar byas te/ gso sbyong legs par blangs/ nyin mo bdag mdun bum bzlas bdag 'jug bcas grub pa'i rjes su sbyin sreg ci 'grub dang mchod bstod bya/ rgyas par mi nus pas kyang mdor bsdus tsam nges par bsgrub dgos/ de nas lhung bzed nang du dkar gsum mngar gsum dang sbyar ba'i zho zan gyi ril bu blugs/ dar tshon gyis kha bkab pa'i steng dam tshig gi rdo rjer mos pa'i rdo rje bzhag la rang dang dkyil 'khor gyi mdun bar du bkod/

brtson pas lcogs na de nas rgyun ma chad par mtshan thog thag /phyir nang nam ma langs bar bzlas brjod ma chad par bya dgos pas thun mtshams bza' btung la sogs pa'i tshe na'ang yid 'don bya/ de ltar mi lcogs na nyin mo bzlas pa gtor chog sogs la brtson par byas te/ sang tho rangs snga ba'i char langs la bdag mdun bum bzlas sbyin sreg rjes gnang mchod bstod kyi bar gzhung ltar grub rjes lhung bzed lag g.yon tu bzhag /g.yas pas kha bkab la bzlas pa byas pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin 'od zer kha dog sna lnga dpag tu med pa byon te ril bu la thim pas dngos grub kyi dbyig chen por 'khyil bar bsgoms la bzlas pa ci tsam nus pa byas la lhung bzed mdun tu bzhag go /gal te mtshan la bzla na'ang sgrub mchod tshar gcig tsam gyis chog pas dngos grub blang ba'i bzlas dmigs de nyid ma chad par bya/ sgra 'od la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung bar bshad kyang deng sang 'grub rtags dkon pas/ nam langs pa dang bzlas pa'i 'phro brtul/ mchod pa gsar pa bsham/ dkyil chog ltar phul ba'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la rang rang gi skal pa dang 'tshams pa'i phrin las rnam pa gsum dang dngos grub rnam pa gsum dang byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi bka' drin stsal nas/ mthar thug thams cad kyang rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jog par mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs su 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad pa dang*/ sdig pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad rab tu zhi ba dang*/

'dod pa'am bsam gtan gyi bde ba kha na ma tho ba med pas phyogs kun tu khyab cing rgyas pa dang*/ rnam dkar dge ba chos kyi dga' ston bla na med pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ nad dang 'khrugs pa dang mu ge la sogs pa 'jigs pa dang nyam nga ba thams cad zhi nas/ 'gro ba thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang*/ bdag cag dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la yongs su brten bar bgyid pa rnams mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ pha ma dang*/ grogs dang*/ 'khor dang*/ yon bdag dang bcas pa rnams la tshe dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ las kyi rgyud rab 'byams 'grub pa dang*/ rang rang gi skal pa dang mtsham par 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub kyi tshogs thams cad stsal du gsol/ brtse bas bzung du gsol/ byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyi don gyi mchog thams cad 'grub par gyur cig /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab cing rdzas la longs spyod pas tshe ring ba dang nad nyung ba dang 'brel tshad don ldan gyi dngos grub thob pa'i rten 'brel 'grigs par 'gyur ro// de nas nongs bshags/ 'dod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ bdag bskyed bsdu ba/ rgyun spyod sogs dkyus ltar byas la/ mi mnyam pa'i yan lag gi phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ g.yon pa'i thal mo gan rkyal gyi steng du g.yas pa'i rgyab sbyar/ sor mo rnams bsnol ba'i rtse mo bkug ste/ rtsa ba'i phyogs su bstan pa g.yon tu bskor te/ oṃ hu lu hu lu tsaṇ+ḍa li li ma taṃ gi swā hā/ ces gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i rig pas rwa ba la sogs pa dgrol bar bya'o// me tog 'thor la bkra shis rgya cher brjod/ grub na de'i rjes su'ang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis nyes pa sor gzhug cing*/ 'dir ma grub kyang snga ma dag ni nges par dgos kyi snga ma'i go chu rub 'dir byas pas go mi chod do// bzhi pa grub pa'i spyod pa la gnyis/

dngos dang*/ mtshon byed do// dang po ni/ thun mong ba rdzas lus longs spyod kyi mkha' spyod la brten nas dka' ba med pa yid la gang bsam 'grub pas don gnyis byed la/ thun mong ma yin pa sems bskyed chung na nyan rang dang*/ lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan na mkha' spyod kyi brten las sngags kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa spyad pas 'bras bu'ang sku gsum gyi go 'phang mngon tu 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ bya spyod dag gi dngos grub sgrub pa mtshan nyid pa deng sang lag tu mi lon pas sgrub pa'i spyod pa sa bcad tsam zhig lag tu bkal ba ltar/ grub pa'i spyod pa'ang rgyun gyi rnal 'byor tsam la gtad so 'cha' dgos shing*/ de'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rgyud bskul bas bsnyen pa'i rgyun de nyid mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir nyin re bzhin skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon tu 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor mthar bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar du chags med tshul gyis nyams su blangs bas/ las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ba dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa ma lus par zad par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa mdo las gsungs so// gnyis pa rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don tu bya ba sbyin sreg gi rim pa ni/ bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung zhing lhag chad kha skong ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'i phyag len la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ lugs 'dir rgyas pa shar dang zhi ba byang du phyogs dgos pas bsnyen rkyang la de ltar dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na zhi ba'i thab khung dkyil 'khor gyi byang du thab kyi lha rnams zhal dkyil 'khor phyogs la ston/ sbyin sreg byed pa po thab khung dang dkyil 'khor gyi bar du 'dug ste/ dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten cing thab la mngon tu phyogs pas bya/

thab stegs su dang po tshangs zur gyi thig gdab/ tshangs thig dbus nas sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad kyis zlum por bskor/ de nas sor bzhi bkyed nas zlum por bskor ba mu ran/ yang sor bzhi bkyed nas bskor ba kha khyer/ de'i steng du logs thig gru bzhir gdab ste/ de'i gra bzhir rdo rje/ kha khyer la pad+ma 'dab brgyad phyi phreng ba/ nang gi zlum po'i khong par pad+ma'i gcus thig gdab/ de yang lte ba gsum cha/ 'dab ma gsum gnyis su byas pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la lha'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig le bkod/ nags kyi lci skam srog chags med pas thab kyi zlum bskor dang mthun par rgya khru gang*/ zabs su khru phyed de'i shar lhor me tshang 'cha'/ ku sha mtshon byed rtsa yi gdan la g.yas su me lha dang*/ dkyil 'khor lha'i bsreg rdzas te bsreg rdzas tshar gnyis 'god de/ de'ang bya rgyud spyir zhi ba la sbrang rtsi 'o ma mar 'o thug nas 'bras til dang dūrba lo ma dang bcas pa la sogs pa'o// rgyas pa la yang 'o ma dang 'o thug dang zho dang lag pan dang nas chan dang til dkar nag dang sgron shing gi dum bu dang nā ga puṣ+pa dang shu ti dang nye shing dang bil ba dang gro dang sran ma la sogs pa dgos par gsungs shing gcig la med cing dgos pa rnams gcig gis kha skong bya bar yang bshad mod/ 'dir dze tā ri'i rgya gzhung las/ mar dang gro nas sran ma dang*// zho dang sman dang dū rba dang*// ku sha yams shing me tog dang*// til dang nyung kar la sogs bsregs// ces pa ltar til la sogs pa de rnams tshogs par bya/ de nyid las/ khyad par las su bya ba ni// til dang nyungs kar dag la ni// brgya'am stong ngam khri ru bsreg /sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i las su// ces pa bsnyen pa'i kha skong sogs sdig pa dang sdug bsngal zhi byed kyi skabs/ til dang yungs kar sngags grangs dang bstun 'dod nges dang*/ de mnyam dkyil 'khor lha'i bsreg rdzas te bsreg rdzas tshar gnyis/

bsangs chu'am/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ las bum dngos sam bum chu dung phor sogs su blugs pas kyang rung ste de rnams bshams/ g.yon tu rigs sngags kyi gzi byin bskyed pa'i dri chab gcig dang*/ rtsa ba'i mchod yon snod gtsang mar spos chu me tog dkar pos bkang ba/ yang snod gtsang mar khyad par mchod yon 'o ma 'bras yos bcas pa'i mchod yon rtswa ku sha bcas pa/ nyer spyod tshar gnyis me lha'i 'bul gtor rnams bsham/ sreg blugs byed pa po'i mdun tu me yol/ rtsigs pa'i nang du rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba dang*/ de dang nye ba len stabs bde ba'i phyogs gang yang 'os par mar khu dang*/ yams shing ni 'o ma can gyi shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba/ sboms su mthe bong ngam mthe'u chung gi tshad/ srid du khru gang ngam khu tshur gnyis bcangs ba'i tshad/ phan tshun ring thung mnyam pa/ gas chag dang rma med pa/ rgyu ma rul ba/ ngo bo ma 'khyogs pa/ de'i rtse mo gnyis mar ram/ sbrang ngam/ 'o ma la sogs pas legs par byugs pa grangs mang*/ rlung g.yab dang*/ 'phral la bso ba'i bud shing dang*/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang bcas pa legs par bsham/ de nas sgrub pa po rgyan dkar pos brgyan pa/ zhi ba'i bsam pas gdan nang tshang can gyi steng du zhi ba la pad+ma'i skyil krung dang*/ rgyas pa la bkra shis skyil krung ste bzang po'i stabs kyis kha shar phyogs su phyogs pas 'dug ste/ bsnyen pa'i skabs bdag bskyed dang bzlas pa bsdu ldangs bar byas/ skabs 'dir rgya gzhung las/ las dus rjes kyi bcom ldan ni// khrus dang sbyin sreg la sogs dkar// zhes sogs dang*/ de ltar byas na las rnams 'grub// ces 'byung bas/ bdag nyid bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa// sku mdog dkar po mtshan dper ldan// zhes bsgyur zhing*/ sbyin sreg dngos gzhi'i skabs su'ang de ltar bsgyur dgos/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na chu dang cod pan gyi dbang len dgos pas bdag 'jug yan rdzogs par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi/

yo byad sgrub pa/ 'jig rten pa mchod pa/ dkyil 'khor pa mchod pa/ mjug sdud pa'o// dang po ni/ bsangs chu'am las bum gyi chu la dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang ba'i chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ rdzas thams cad kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor rtsa sngags 'bring po lan bdun dang*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar hūm̐ ring po bdun nam nyer gcig brjod/ gzi byin bskyed pa'i dri chab la dmigs te/ na mo lo ka ḍhi tā ya/ oṃ shang ka re/ shan+ti ka re/ ghuṭ+ṭa ghuṭ+ṭa ghuṭ+ṭa ni ghā ta ya ghuṭ+ṭi ni swā hā/ oṃ ku lan+dha ri ban+dha ban+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mā ma kī'i rigs sngags dang*/ snying po gnyis nyer gcig /dz+wa la dz+wa la ya phaṭa/ sid+dhi sā dha ya phaṭa/ di be di bā ya phaṭa/ ces pa rnams kyang ci rigs par bzlas/ dri chab des mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas thams cad la bsangs gtor byas te/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor dang sngags bshad ma thag pa de rnams lan gcig gi mthar/ oṃ gzi brjid ldan pas rdzas nang du// phyi bshol ma mdzad bzhugs nas su// kun gyi gzi brjid spel ba dang*// byin rlabs can tu mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ dha/ ces dang*/ dzi na dzika /mang du brjod/ dpal 'bar thogs la/ a mṛ te dang dzi na dzika bzla bzhin tu me sbar/ mar khu blugs gzar gyis cung zad bcus te blugs la/ gdangs ring pos swā hā dang hā yig ring po lan mang du brjod cing bsgyings pa dang bcas par bya'o// oṃ dang bh+rūm̐ mang du brjod/ rlung yab kyis g.yabs/ ku sha la sogs pa'i rtsa sngon po'i bam po thogs la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed te// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// 'dis bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gegs med cing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol zhes brjod/

de nas rang gi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas thabs kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du snga ma snga ma'i rtse mo phyi ma phyi ma'i rtsa bas non par bkram mo// thab la bsangs chu 'thor// stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thabs khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyar khru gang ba/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ mu ran dang kha khyer sor bzhi pa la pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor ba/ phyi rol gyi stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir rdo rje re res mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i nang zhi ba'i me dkar la bsil bar 'bar ba'i dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan grub par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ lag gnyis khu tshur las gung mo sgreng ba'i tshigs gsum par mdzum mo'i rtse mo sbyar/ g.yas snying gar phyir bstan g.yon dkur bzhag /mthe bong nang du g.yab la/ oṃ/ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye ha bya ka bya ba hā nā ya swā hā/ zhes me lha'i sngags thung bas spyan drangs/ bdud rtsi'i sngags dang bsang chu 'thor/ me lha'i sngags thung gis mar khu dgang blugs gsum 'bul/ thab kyi dbus su drang srong chen po me lha sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis kyis dbyig pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis gnas pa/ 'khor drang srong gi tshogs thams cad kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ki li kī la badz+ra bhi ma ro dris mi tra ma hā kro dhā ya bi dza ya ni krin+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ban+da ban+da swā hā/ zhes bgegs bsangs/ spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong mdzub mo'i glor bzhag pa dang me lha'i sngags thung brjod pas dam la bzhag /oṃ ag+na ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ā di bya ā di bya la swā hā/ ces me lha'i sngags ring pas mar khu dang yams shing 'bul/

oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ha ri siṅga la lo hita ak+ṣa de hi da dā pa ya hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba bigh+nen nā sha ya swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di kho nas dkar gsum dang 'bru sna la sogs pa me lha nyid kyi bsreg rdzas rnams ji tsam 'os pa rim gyis 'bul/ yang gong bzhin oṃ ag+na ye sogs sngags thung bas dgang blugs lan gsum la sogs pa ji tsam 'os pa 'bul/ skabs de dag tu me bkra ngan pa dag byung na/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags kyis bsangs chu gtor bas bzlog par 'gyur ro// mthar/ bdag gi sbyin sreg gi las 'di gegs med cing 'bras bu'i mchog dang ldan par mdzad du gsol// ces gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ me lha thabs kyi zung na ci bder bzhugs par gyur/ zhes mos/ skabs 'dir 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i me lha la mchod yon nyer spyod gtor ma dgang blugs bstod pa rnams grub nas gshegs gsol byas na bya rgyud rang lugs yin pas cho ga'i rim pa 'di ltar bzang mod/ spyi 'gros kyi rigs pa 'di la'ang 'gal ba med pas thos chung mgu byed du bgyis pa'o// gsum pa ni/ bud shing gso/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ sarba tha ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan gsum gyis lha'i gdan grub par gyur/ mchod yon spos kyis bdug /bh+rūm̐ bdun dang*/ dzi na dzika ྄bdun/ oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ bhan+dha swā hā/ ji ltar rigs pas byin gyis brlabs la rtsa ba'i mchod yon mdun gyi dbus su bzhag /g.yon tu khyad par gyi mchod yon dang*/ g.yas su bdug spos rnams bshams te/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ zhes lan gsum gyis phyag 'tshal/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ mdzub mo gnyis rtse mo sbyar te bsgrengs/ mthe bong g.yab cing*/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'dir// bdag gi mchod yon 'di bzhes la// mchod pas bdag la dges par mdzod// bh+rūm̐ dzi na dzik ak+ṣo bh+ya e h+me hi/

zhes lan gsum la sogs par gsol ba 'debs pas nan tan gyis spyan drangs/ de yang phyag rgya spyi bo'i thad du byas te/ lan dang po phyag rgya kho na bya/ gnyis pa la phyag rgya des mchod yon gtsang ma thogs te/ spyi bo'i thad nas bzed zhal du 'bul/ gsum pa la rdzas sbyar ba'i mchod yon thogs te 'bul/ rdzas rnams dngos su med na/ chu gtsang ngam me tog tsam dang bcas pa 'bul zhing*/ lhag ma dmigs pa kho nas 'grub bo// de nas phyag rgya pad+ma kha phye ba'i tshul can gyis// bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ ka ma lā ya swā hā/ yang phyag rgya de dang 'dra ba las gung mdzub srin gsum rdo rje rtse lnga lta bur byas la/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra ā pa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ pad+ma kha phye las/ sor mo dbus ma gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs ba dang*/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad so so rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa// sku mdog dkar po sogs nas/ bkra shis lha mo brgyad bskyed tshig rgyas bsdus gang rigs te/ bsdus pa ltar na/ dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan gsal// zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal gdab/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na 'dir me tog len pa dang*/ rjes gshegs pa sogs bod rnying pa'i phyag bzhes ltar spro na byar rung*/ skabs 'dir sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na gshegs rigs kyi dam rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tod+bha ba swā hā/

zhes brjod/ gang ltar de nas sgrub mchod skabs ltar/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ 'jig rten khams ni sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal ba zla bas bstod/ de nas mar gyi dgang blugs sngon tu 'gro ba'i/ yams shing nas brtsams bsreg rdzas thams cad rim bzhin 'bul te/ sngags ni rgya gzhung las/ thams cad rgyun gcod sngags kyis bya// zhes pas gzungs ring kho nas 'bul/ bod skad kyi spel tshig sbyar ba spro na/ bsreg rdzas tshan re'i mtshams su/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā zhes brjod/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong la mar khu'i dgang blugs brgya phrag man gang 'grub dang*/ bsreg rdzas gzhan cha snyoms pa'i grangs nyer gcig yan gang 'grub song mtshams/ til dang yungs kar kho na la grangs bzung*/ gzungs sngags kho na grangs tshad 'grub par dka' na/ gshegs rigs kyi rigs pa'i rgyal po dang*/ rigs kyi snying po yin pas/ bh+rum̐ dzi na dzik /ces pa'i yi ge lnga pos kha skong bar byas kyang rung bar mngon/ mthar gzungs sngags bdun dang*/ lha mo brgyad kyi mtshan sngags gsum res dgangs blugs 'bul/ mchod bstod bzod gsol dkyil chog ltar byas pa'i rjes su/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te a k+ṣo bh+yā ya ār+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha swā hā/ des 'gres te lha mo brgyad kyi sngags mthar ār+ghaṃ sogs sbyar bas mchod yon 'bul/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na sngar gyi me tog cung zad tsam dkyil 'khor la gtor/ me nang du bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams slar phyir la gshegs la/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas su rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba'i skabs spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya las/ mthe bong gnyis phyir bskyed/ gshegs gsol gyi tshig spyi 'gro'i mthar/ gdon mi za bar bdag la yang*// rjes su brtse bar dgongs nas kyang*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// ci bde bar ni gshegs su gsol// dang por bcings pa'i de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya de mgo bo'i steng du bcas/

rtse mo gyen tu bstan/ sor mo bskyed cing dkrol te/ se gol tog pa lan gsum dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to d+bha wā ya swā hā/ ces lan gsum gyis lha rnams gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ bzhi pa ni/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams gong smos tiṣ+ṭha ha ri'i sngags kyis grangs ji tsam 'os pa phul mthar/ sngags de'i swā hā'i gong du ār+ghaṃ sogs sbyar bas mchod yon nyer spyod rnams dang*/ ba liṃ sbyar ba lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ slar yang me lha'i sngags ring bas dgang blugs lan bdun gyi mthar/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir// thugs rje sprul pa'i sku sprul pa// rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul// nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od// bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan// thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa chibs// rigs sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin// bdud rtsi'i bcud ghun+dhe bsnams// chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten 'das kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes brjod/ spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong phyir bskyed/ oṃ ag+na ye sogs sngags thung ba'i mthar/ gats+tsha gats+tsha zhes brjod pas gshegs su gsol// bzhud cig ces ni bdag po'i bka'// bzlos pas rab tu bsgrags nas bzhud// spyan yang drangs ma thag tu ni// gsang sngags dgyes nas 'byon par mdzod// ces pa'ang spro na brjod/ mthar smon lam dang shis brjod rgyas par bya/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ me ma shi bar du gzhan reg tu mi 'jug cing mi dkrug /longs yod na 'o ma'i chus bkrus la thal ba snod gtsang mar bsdus te/ chu'i nang na gnas pa'i srog chags mang po la phan gdags pa'i phyir rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pa'i chur dor/

thabs kyi nye 'khor dri zhim po'i chus byugs te las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// sgrub pa'i dngos grub len pa'i gong du'ang zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis 'thus mod kyis/ rgyas pa bya bar 'dod na thab spyi mtshungs dang*/ gzhan 'di nyid la kha bsgyur bar chog go /spyod rgyud lugs kyi sbyin sreg cung bya dka' ba dang*/ 'dir yan lag thams cad bya rgyud lugs gzhir bzhag pa ma zad rgya gzhung las tshul 'di gsal bar bshad pas bya rgyud rang lugs su bkod pa'o// gsum pa gzhan la phan gdags pa'i rim pa la gnyis/ gson po la phan gdags pa dang*/ gshin po la phan gdags pa'o// dang po la gsum/ srung ba gdags pa/ srung dmigs bya ba/ bkru bya bsrung gsum bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis las 'khor lo gdags par 'dod na/ dar ras gro shog gang rung la 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'am brgyad pa bris la/ lte bar oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni bri/ rtsibs bzhi par byed na shar gyi rtsibs la ro tsa ni ro tsa ni bri/ lhag ma 'gre/ brgyad byed na sngags tshan phral te shar rtsibs la ro tsa ni gong ma bri/ lhag ma 'gre/ mu khyud la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ che ge mo'i sarba karma pa raṃ pa ra ṇi me rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes yig 'go thams cad phyir bstan g.yon skor du bri/ tshon thob ni/ lte ba dkar/ rtsibs ser/ gzhi sngo/ mu khyud dmar/ de'i phyi rol rwa ba ser po bya/ yang*/ lugs gcig la/ pad 'dab dgu bris pa'i lte bar hūm̐ gi mthar che ge mo la srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ nub kyi 'dab ma la na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ nub byang gi 'dab ma la oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni bri'o// lhag ma 'gre gsung*/ lag len tu snga ma mdzad/ glegs bam ste shog dril gdags par 'dod na/ rgya shog la phe la gi wang dang gur gum/ mo la rgya skyegs kyi khu bas gzungs sngags tshar gsum mam bdun bri/ sarba karma'i gong du bsrung bya'i ming gzhug /mthar rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/

gnyis ka la rab gnas bya ba ni/ stegs gtsang mar rin po che'i snod 'bru yis bkang pa la bkram/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon tu 'gro bas zhi drag gi sbyong ba dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas pa'i bum chus khrus gsol/ mdun tu mchod pa bsham/ rang mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams nas bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod ba rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs par gyur/ spos 'thul la/ hūm̐ dad pa dang ni sogs kyis spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs la mchod bstod bya/ 'og srung dmigs skabs ltar tshig lhug gi phyag 'tshal bden pa bskul pa'i mthar/ byin gyis brlabs kyis bsrung bya ngan song gsum dang mi khoms pa'i gnas rnams su skye ba'i las thams cad dang*/ dge ba'i bar du gcod pa mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa mtha' dag dang*/ rmi lam mtshan ltas ngan pa 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug sogs dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba/ nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa mtha' dag zhi ba dang srung ba chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ gsol ba gdab pas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa yig 'bru'i rnam par zhu nas tsa kra'am glegs bam la thim pas lha'i rang bzhin srung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsa bzlas pa'i me tog lan nyer gcig gam bdun 'thor la ye dhar dang su pra tīṣ+ṭha sbrel ma brjod/ 'di kho na che ge mo'i srung ba'i go cha chen po gzhom gzhig dang bral bar gyur cig /ces brjod la/ 'khor lo lte ba chings spyi 'gre dang*/ shog dril 'go nas yig ngo nang bstan tu dril/ bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ la chas btums pa'am g.yogs legs par byas la btags pa'i phan yon spyir tshad med cing*/ khyad par gzungs las/

lus la 'chang ngam/ glegs bam la bris nas mgul du thogs te 'chang na/ de la dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba rnams gtan tu 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa srung dmigs ni/ mdo'i dgongs pa dang gter ma'i man ngag grub chen chags med rin po ches bkral ba ste/ rang nyid yi dam skur gsal thugs ka yi// sa bon 'od zer shar gyi phyogs su 'phros// shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams na// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i thugs kar phog /sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam rjes su dran// sku las 'od zer mthing ga 'phros pa yis// nad dang sdug bsngal 'jigs skrag gnod pa kun// mun la nyi shar bzhin tu bsal bar gyur// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pas sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa na/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis dam bcas pa dang*/ tshig brjod pa gang yin pa'i dam bcas pa dang*/ tshig brjod pa de dag thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cing dam bcas pa dang*/ tshig brjod pa de dag thams cad kyi pha rol tu son pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i tshig des bdag cag dpon slob bam/ bsrung bya 'di la 'jigs pa'am/ gdon nam/ rims nad kyi bar du gcod pa sogs kha sgyur la/ 'di dag da lta nyid du zhi zhing nub par gyur cig gzungs ring lan kha shas dang*/ oṃ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥdzaḥ bigh+nān+ta kṛ tra hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'jigs pa dang gnod pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs gal che chung longs skabs dang sbyar ba'i bzlas dmigs mthar/ shis brjod byas pas las kyi rnam par smin pa ma gtogs pa'i gnod pa thams cad de ma thag tu zhi bar 'gyur ba gsungs shing*/ don la'ang skyob srung gzhan gang las kyang zab nges pa'i nyams myong can yin snyigs dus su chos sgrub pa la bdud kyis lhag par bar du gcod par byed cing*/

mi 'khrugs pa'i mtshan gzung ba tsam gyis kyang bdud kyi gnas thams cad dkrugs shing bdud kyi spyod yul las rab tu 'da' bar gsungs pas/ rang gi rgyun gyi nyams len tu'ang shin tu zab par go zhing*/ de lta na/ byin gyis rlabs kyis/ zhes pa'i mjug tu/ dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad myur du zhi zhing nub par gyur cig /ces bsgyur ro// gsum pa bkru byab srung gsum bya ba ni/ de'ang gzungs las/ lan gcig bzlas brjod byas na/ ltas ngan pa dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa rnams med par 'gyur ro// ces dang*/ dze tā ri'i rgya gzhung du/ ngan pa bzlog la las 'di bya// ces gsungs pa ltar/ rmis ltas ngan pa dang*/ mo ngan pa dang*/ chag che ba/ lo zla'i skag /gzhan gyi sbyor ngan/ dmod pa sogs zhi bar 'dod na/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa bcas sngon tu 'gro bas/ dkyil chog ltar mdun bum bsgrub pa dang*/ cha gsum btang*/ bsrung bya mdun tu 'khod/ rgyas par spro na kun rig ltar zhi sbyong phyed ma drag sbyong til sbyong bcas bya/ bsdu na mi dgos/ bum lha nam mkhar yid kyis btegs la/ lha khrus spyi ltar byas pa'i khrus chu slar yang rnam bum du blugs pas bsgrub byar khrus bya zhing*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin sogs tshigs bcad dang*/ gzungs kyi mthar/ che ge mo'i sdig pa sgrib pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin tu gzungs tshar re'i mthar/ bgegs thams cad= nad thams cad= gdon thams cad= gdugs pa can thams cad= rims thams cad= nad 'go ba thams cad= nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad= dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad= rmi lam ngan pa thams cad= ltas ngan pa thams cad= sems kyi g.yeng ba thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ces brjod cing bkru/ byab pa ni/ rgya gzhung las/ a pā na yas byab par bya/ ces pa ltar/ khar bum chu cung zad bzung du gzhug la/ rma bya'i sgro'i dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od zer kyis khyed rang rnams kyi nad rims gdon bgegs thams cad rdo khab len gyi lcags len pa ltar blangs nas phyir dor ba'i mos pa gyis/

gzungs kyi mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pā na ya swā hā/ sogs gong ltar mtha' bsgyur ba brjod cing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i sgros phyi tshul bya/ nad gdon skyugs par bsam la kha'i chu snod du pho// srung ba ni/ rgya gzhung las/ rak+ṣa zhes pas bsrung bar bya// ces pa ltar/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su rdo rjes reg pa la brten de las de 'dra ba'i rdo rje bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung bas lus la rdo rje'i go gyon te bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par byas snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gzungs kyi mthar/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ sogs brjod/ spyi bo/ mdun/ rgyab/ dpung mgo gnyis/ pus mo gnyis te gnas bdun/ rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag pas srung ngo*// de nas rgya gzhung du/ gson por bkra shis rdzas brgyad sbyin// zhes pa ltar shis pa'i slad du bkra shis rdzas rnams la bum chu gtor te/ bsangs sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las maṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis rdzas brgyad che ge mo'i/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ maṅga laṃ aṣ+ṭa dra bya hūm̐/ zhes byin brlabs la/ rdzas brgyad sbyin pa'i tshig rgyas bsdus gang rung brjod pa'i mthar/ bsrung bya rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /ces dang*/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i shis brjod bya/ rjes chog sogs gzhung ltar gyis 'grub po// gal te dbang bskur dang sbrel bar spro na bdag mdun bum pa cha gsum bdag 'jug bcas grub pa'i rjes su sbyor ba sngon tu 'gro ba'i dbang bskur rtags brgyad sbyin pa yan grub mtshams/ lha khrus nas brtsams/ bkru byab srung gsum rdzas brgyad sbyin pa yan grub nas/ srung sngags kyis tsakra sbyin la/ rjes dam tshig man mthar dbyung ngo*// gnyis pa gshin po la phan gdags pa'i rim pa la lnga/

me chog /rus chog /chu chog /sba skyel/ sāts+tsha'i cho ga'o// dang po me la brten pa'i cho ga sbyin sreg ni/ lag len rgyas pa gzhan tu shes/ mdor na thog mar sa btsal/ rnyed nas sa slong ba dang sbyong ba byas la/ las thams cad pa'i sngags bzla bzhin tu thab brtsigs/ dbus su lha mtshan pad+ma 'dab brgyad sogs zhi ba'i thab khung spyi dang mtshungs/ gzungs sngags dang ngan song sbyong ba'i sngags btab pa'i bud shing brtsigs/ bsreg rdzas bud shing sogs la'ang yungs kar la las sngags bzlas pas brabs/ ras sam shog gur pad+ma 'dab brgyad khru gang pa'i lte bar 'khor los mtshan pa bris shing zhun mar gyis bgos pa ro'i gdan tu bting*/ bdag mdun bum chog bdag 'jug bcas zin pa'i rjes su/ ro la gzungs chog gi bsgrubs pa'i bum chus bkru/ snam ras kyis phyi/ de dag dngos su ma 'byor na'ang mtshon byed bya/ gnas yig rgyas pa/ gzhan yang grub na legs shing*/ dmigs bsal spyi bor oṃ dang gzungs ring pra ti ha na'i mthar/ che ge mo'i lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags dang bcas pa sarba karma sogs dang*/ mgrin par āḥdang*/ gzungs ring gsham/ che ge mo'i ngag gi sgo nas sogs/ snying gar hūm̐ dang gzungs ring gsham/ che ge mo'i yid kyi sgo nas zhes sogs kyi sham bu sbyar ba mthing shog la gser dngul lam/ ma 'byor na rgya shog la dri bzang bsres pa'i mtshal gyis bris te gnas so sor yig ngo nang bstan tu dgris te sbyar/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros rten de'i sdig sgrib sbyong bar bsams la gzungs sngags sham bu can de mang du brjod la sngags bzla bzhin tu rab byung yin na chos gos/ khyim pa la ras snam kyis dkris te sngags kyis btab pa'i bdug pas bdug /dkyil 'khor lho sgor pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du bzhag la rten bskyed 'gugs pa sbyong ba rnam gsum til sbyong brabs pa bkrub dug sbyong skyabs 'gro dbang bskur rdzogs par byas ba'i rjes su lam sbyong bstan byas/

slar yang skad cig gis phung po lhar gsal/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la mchod pa lngas mchod/ slob dpon rdor dril thogs shing gzungs sngags brjod pas sna drangs te bsreg khang du mgo slob dpon la bstan nas/ dkris phung de ltag pa'i phyogs su bzhag /zhi ba'i sreg blugs dkyus bzhin bya ba las/ me sbar skabs/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu sogs brjod/ bsreg rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab pa'i tshe/ tshe las 'das pa'i phung khams skye mched dang*/ bsreg rdzas rnams tha mi dad pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par mos/ 'jig rten pa'i lugs bdun song mtshams/ me lha rdo rje las kyi gtso// tshe 'das sems can sbyong ba dang*// lha rnams chams tshims par bya ba'i phyir// 'di nyid du ni phrin las mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas me lha'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus tshe 'das kyi sdug bsngal sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad drangs te ro dang bsreg rdzas rnams dang gnyis su med pa bdud rtsi'i dwangs mar byas te bzhes par bsam/ bsreg rdzas sngags sham du/ tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyar/ dkyil 'khor pa'i bstod pa rgyal ba zla ba'i rjes su/ nam mkha'i mdangs ldan kun nas gsal ba'i sku// mtshan dpes rab mdzes rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs// rdo rje dang bcas bdud 'dul mnyam gzhag mdzad// mgon po mi 'khrugs sku la phyag 'tshal lo// che ge zhes bya ba'i tshe 'das rigs kyi bu'i// thog med nas bsags srog gcod la sogs pa'i// lus kyi sgrib pa ma lus dag gyur nas// mi 'gyur rdo rje sku yi dngos grub stsol// lha yi rnga bo che ltar rnam kun tu// rnam par rtogs med legs bshad seng ge'i sgra// yan lag drug cu'i brgyan pa legs sgrogs pa// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// che ge zhes bya'i tshe 'das rigs kyi bu'i// thog med nas bsags rdzun tshig la sogs ba// ngag gi sgrib pa ma lus dag gyur nas// yan lag drug cu gsung gi dngos grub stsol// ye shes rgya mtsho yon tan nor bus brgyan// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa'i rba rlabs can// srid zhi'i rlung gis rnam par mi g.yo ba// mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// che ge zhes bya'i tshe 'das rigs kyi bu'i// thog med nas bsags brnab sems la sogs pa'i// yid kyi dri ma ma lus dag gyur nas// ye shes lnga ldan thugs kyi dngos grub stsol// gtso bo dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang bcas kyis// tshe 'das che ge la sogs 'gro rnams la// sgrib med ye shes spyan gyis legs gzigs nas// brtse ba'i thugs rje chen pos legs gzung la// sngon chad bsags pa'i sgrib pa gang mchis dang*// bag chags dang bcas sgrib pa sol mdzod la// srid dang rnam grol bde ba gang lags pa// dngos grub bde chen myur du bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas ltung ba slong ba'i sngags rgyas ngan song gsum tshe 'das dang bcas pa gtso bo'i mdun tu bkug par bsam/

'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang*/ sdig pa dgugs pa'i sngags kyis tshe las 'das pa de'i sdig pa thams cad kyang bkug par bsam/ sdig pa sbyong ba'i sngags dang*/ sdig pa bral ba'i sngags rgyas tshe las 'das pa'i sdig pa thams cad bkug cing dral te/ ro dang bsreg rdzas rnams la thim ste/ ye shes kyi mes gsol bar bsam/ bsreg rdzas rnams phul la/ gzungs sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya che ge mo'i pā paṃ ni da ha swā hā/ zhes btags te phul bas/ lha thams cad kyis tshe las 'das pa de'i lus la dbang bskur zhing sdig sgrib dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal la sogs pa zhi bar byas par bsam/ rdzas tshan re'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad yongs su sbyong ba dang*/ myur du 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las 'don pa'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces sbyar/ bsreg rdzas rdzogs pa'i mthar/ tshe 'das hūm̐ gi sa bon las skyes pa'i gtso bo'i sku rdo rje lta bur bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃ gis bsrung ba bya/ lha rnams kyi 'od zer gyis dbang bskur bar bsams la/ mjug tu lam sbyang bstan rnams byas la/ sbyin sreg dang dkyil 'khor rjes kyi bya ba gzhung ltar bgyid pa ni phal pa'i ro mchod rdzas kyi tshul du sbyong ba'o// ༈ //gang zag mchog gam rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma lta bu yin na/ bkru zhing gnas yig gdags pa yan sngar dang 'dra/ sku chas legs par byas la bsangs sbyang sngon tu 'gro bas gtso bor bskyed/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug la sogs pa nas mchod bstod kyi bar rgyas par byas la gzungs ci nus bzla/ khrus gsol gos zung 'bul ba lha khrus ltar grub nas mchod bstod mdor bsdus rjes bsreg thab tu rol mo mchod pa dang bcas pas spur gdan drangs te/

de'i thugs kar dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bskyed nas/ de dang spur gyi ye shes pa gcig tu bsres pha la mchod bstod sngon tu 'gro bas/ oṃ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzod// ces sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis me sbar bar bsam shing chos 'brel med pa'i mi zhig bos te thab tu me spor du gzhug /de la/ gson cig dgongs shig sogs kyi tshab tu/ dpal ldan bla ma dgongs su gsol// zhes 'don pa spos la brjod/ me sbar bas sngar spur lhar bskyed pa de gsal bar bsgoms la/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i sbyin sreg sngar dang 'dra bar bya/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang bla ma dbyer med du mos/ zhi ba'i sreg blugs dkyus su bstan pa de nyid las phal pa'i ro sreg la smos pa'i kha 'gengs de rigs mi dgos/ spel tshig tu/ dpal kun bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams gang na bzhugs ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bar chad dang*/ gdul byar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sbyar ro// rjes gdung khang bcas la zhag gsum mam bdun tu mchod pa bya ba sogs spyi ltar ro// gnyis pa rus chog ni/ cho gas bsregs pa'i rus bu rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin 'od zer gyi rdul phra rab rus pa la thim pas sdig sgrib sbyong zhing byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgya dang*/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes lan mang du brjod pas bsdus la/ me tog dkar po dkram pa'i khar pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar rin po che'i snod dam kham phor du bzhag /bdag bum sgrub bzlas sngon tu 'gro bas/ rus bu rnams kyi steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la yi ge a dkar po/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun skya chi li li bab pas tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad sangs kyis dag par gyur par mos la/

'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin sogs phyin drug dug sbyong ba'i tshigs bcad yongs rdzogs brjod cing bar rnams su/ gzungs sngags sham bu can brjod pas bkru/ mthar yang gzungs sngags sham can dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pra mar+dha na pra mar+dha na swā hā/ ci 'grub bzla bzhin pas bkru/ gang ser mas shis pa brjod/ nye du ma yin pas zhib par btags la dri bzang dang bsres pa'i 'jim pa mdun tu bzhag /de'i steng du skad cig gis mi 'khrugs pa gsal/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po mi 'khrugs pas tshe las 'das pa'i sgrib gnyis byang tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ tshe 'das kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ tshur 'dus te bcom ldan 'das 'od du zhu nas rus pa la thim pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa'i rin po che'i phung por gyur/ zhes mos la sāts+tsha'i cho ga gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ lugs 'di la gtso bor rus pa brdung ba nas/ sāts+tsha grub kyi bar gzungs sngags kho nas las thams cad byed pa yin pas de nyid bzla par bya/ nang gzhug gzungs kyi shog dril 'jug /rab gnas 'chad 'gyur ltar byas grub nas bskor lam du bzhag kyang ha cang 'gal ba med rung*/ blo chung nyes pa dgag pa'i phyir dben par mgo mjug ma log pa gral bsgrigs la bzhag /de'ang mi bde na phyis chur bab par 'gyur ba'i bde lam mam/ chu klung du bsgrig pa'i tshul gyis gshegs na phan yon che'o// 'di ni phal pa la bya ba'i tshul te mchog la rus pa bkru ba sogs mi dgos pas/ sāts+tsha'i cho ga kho na bya ba yin no// gsum pa chu chog tu grags pa'i lag len ni/ sbyong rgyud las/ ro la sngags kyis btab nas kyang*// chu chog gis ni bkru bar bya// zhes dang*/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung dor// de ltar yang ni sdig can yang*// ngan song las ni thar gyur na// 'jig rten bsod nams lta ci smos// zhes sdig sbyong sgo dgu'i ya gyal du gsungs pa'i rung mthun sbyor ba 'di bya sla phan yon che bkra shis pa yin pas/

bdag mdun bum sgrub/ ro bkru phyi/ gnas yig gdags nas dkris dang bdug pa rnams dang*/ rten bskyed nas skyabs 'gro'i bar yang sbyin sreg dang khyad par med pa las/ de nas gang du dor ba'i chu bkra legs pa'i khar gnas bdag la dkar gtor gser skyems 'bul/ chu bo bsangs sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ yig las byung ba'i chu bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun chen por gyur/ oṃ tap+te dap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ lan gsum/ lha'i chu bo gaṅga'i bkug nas thim pas dag byed kyi rang bzhin can tu gyur/ oṃ na ma s+t+rai ya dhī sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya r+bhe/ dz+wa la dharmā dhā tu gar+bhe/ saṃ ha ra ṇa ā yuḥsaṃ sho dha ya/ pā paṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa man+ta/ bi ma la aṣ+ṇi ṣa bi shud+dhe/ ma hā bi ra dze ra gam+bhī ra si/ dharmā dhā tu bi bi sā ra a ma mā ki swā hā/ chu bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdul phra rab tu gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje bskul/ byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par byon nas sku'i rdul rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ reg tshad kyi 'gro ba 'bad med du grol ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa de nyid kyis tshe 'das kyi sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib bkru bar gyur/ phung po rdo dang sgrags te chu'i gting du dor ba'i khar rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu bsgrengs la/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// sogs khrus kyi tshigs rnams dang mtshams su gzungs sngags sham bu bcas brjod/ ye shes kyi chu rgyun gyis tshe 'das kyi lus bkrus sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyangs lam lnga sa bcu rim gyis bgrod par gyur/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam// rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun byang nas// 'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog

/oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+ne rat+na sam+bha we/ rat+na kī ra ṇe rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe shod+dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes a dkar po dri ma med pa'i rnam pa can de shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po mi 'khrugs pa'i thugs kar thim par gyur/ 'di nas nying mtshams sbyar ma thag /dag pa'i zhing khams mngon dga' ru// pad+ma'i snying po dam pa la// rdzus te skye ba len par shog /ces dang*/ mngon dga'i zhing sogs/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam dang bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ cho ga'i rjes kyi rim pa rnams bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ gal te khang pa'i phyogs gcig gam/ dur ram/ mchad par 'jog par 'dod na bkru phyi gnas yig /dkris bdug sngar ltar la/ de'i yi dam dmigs bsal yod na de'i snying po gser gyis bris pa snying gar blan/ rten bskyed nas dbang bskur tshang bar byas te/ bzhag snod rab byung la mchod rten gyi dbyibs dkar po/ dge bsnyen la pad+ma dmar po kha sbyar gyi gzugs/ rgyal po la sngon po gtsug tor lta bu/ blon po la dmar skya za ma tog lta bu/ tha mal pa pho la ser skya gdan khri lta bu/ mo la sngo skya bil ba'i 'bras bu lta bu/ byis pa la dmar ser lhung bzed lta bu/ 'jam zhing dbyibs legs par bzo byas nas/ de'i nang du stan gyi steng du ro kha lhor bstan/ mgo nub tu bstan la cung zad bslang ste lag pa thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag /de'i spyi bo'am snying ga nas srad bu dmar ba zhig btags la/ snod de'i spyi bor bton te nub phyogs su drangs te thog la gdags so// snod de'i steng du gdugs khra bo gcig phub/ snod de'i phyogs bzhir rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa'i gzugs bya/ gzhan yang mchod rdzas dang bza' btung sna tshogs kyis bskor la/ ro de lhar bskyed pa na/ gzungs bzla zhing mchod bstod bar mdun bskyed ltar bya zhing shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod/

khyim du bzhag na rgyun tu'ang mchod par bya'o// ri la skyel na'ang gnas yig sbyong khrus dbang bskur sogs de ltar grub na legs la/ phung po gtor ran pa dang gnas yig rnams rnying ma'i btags grol gyi phyag len ltar rang nyid mi bskyod pa'i thugs ka'i 'od zer dang sngags kyi sgras khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ ngan song rnams sbyangs/ dmigs yul gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing du drangs par bsams la/ gzungs sngags bzla bzhin tu me sgron gyis bsregs pa'i thal ba'ang gnas so sor byug /phung po zag med bdud rtsi myang grol gyi rang bzhin rnam pa sha khrag sogs gang 'dod kyi longs spyod sbyin yul bya gcan rang byung lha'i 'khor lor shes pa'i mchod sbyin gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya zhing mthar sbyin 'bras dmigs med du bsngo// lnga pa sāts+tsha cho ga la gsum/ 'debs pa'i tshul/ rab gnas/ gshegs pa'am bzhugs pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ sa slong thun min grub na legs/ ma grub na gser skyems tsam phul te srog chags med pa'i sa gtsang ma la rin chen sman spos sogs bsres te cho ga spyi ltar ram/ gzungs sngags kho na bzla bzhin tu sāts+tsha 'bum phrag gcig gdab/ nang du tshe 'das kyi ming sarba karma'i gong du bris pa'i gzungs gzhug 'jog dgos pas/ ming spel shes na legs sbyar dang ma shes na bod skad de sbyor lugs dper na/ pra ti ha na phyi ma'i rjes su/ khyim bdag legs skyes kyi sarba karma pa ram+pa rā ṇi sarba pā paṃ k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā zhes sbyor/ me sarba satwa nañtsa sbyor mi dgos/ sāts+tsha rnams gdugs mtshon byed sna tshogs pa'i dar gyi cod pan re rtser sbyar grub na legs so// gnyis pa/ de rnams legs par bsgrigs la rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas bsdus gang 'grub bya dgos kyang mi 'grub na/ bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya/ las bum du 'khyil pa bzla/

de'i sngags ring thung rnams kyis yungs kar dang*/ na mo bud+dha sogs sbrel ba'i rten 'brel snying pos 'thor nas byin brlab/ sbyong ba gsum dang*/ bgegs bskrad/ lha khrus gsol ba dang shis brjod bcas rgyas par bya/ bum pa dang lha mo bcas kyi bskyed tshig dor ba'i lhag ma mdun bskyed ltar gyi bskyed bzlas mchod bstod rgyas pa dang*/ lhag par mchod pa'i rjes su gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang me tog gi phreng ba sogs gang 'byor dngos su bstar/ tha na tsa ka li tsam thogs/ ma 'byor pa yid kyis sprul te/ me tog dam pa sogs sh+lo ka gsum dang mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs sngags kyi rjes su/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten 'di rnams la rin po che'i gdugs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa phul bas zhal dro zhing byin che ba 'gro ba skyob nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /ces rgyal mtshan sogs la'ang rigs 'gres te brjod/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das 'od du zhu ba sāts+tsha'i rnam par gyur/ rten snying bzla bzhin tu me tog 'thor/ slar yang yan lag bdun pa bzang spyod las 'byung ba tsam bya zhing bkra shis brjod la cho ga'i rjes rnams bya/ de tsam yang mi nus na/ gdugs sogs yid kyis phul bar mos/ go myong ldan pa zhig gis rten 'brel snying pos me tog 'thor bas kyang rung mthun tu brtsi dgos so// gsum pa la gshegs bzhugs gnyis las/ sāts+tsha chur gshegs na/ sa dpyad chu bkra legs pa'i gnas su bdag bskyed sngon tu 'gro bas/ mchod pa'i yo byad gsar du bsham/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ deng 'dir 'khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med gyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan lta bu dang ldan par gyur pa'i phyogs kun tu 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pa/

rgyu 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /ces dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra marda na ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+sa sbud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+ra/ ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇe sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum brjod/ 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ sāts+tsha rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos sku'i rten mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin rdul phra rab re re bzhin yang bcom ldan 'das rnam pa snang mdzad chen po'i skur bsams la/ yan lag bdun pa nyid lan gsum bya/ smon lam mthar dbyung*/ spro na skabs 'dir rdul tshon chur gshegs pa'i skabs ltar/ klu chog byas la/ rdul tshon chur gshegs tshab tu 'dir 'jug /klu'i rgyal po khyed rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rten byin rlabs can 'di rnams rgya mtsho chen por spyan drangs la spyir sems can dpag tu med pa la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams su lo phyug rtag tu legs pa dang*/ khyad par bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i nad gdon sdig sgrib tshe'i bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin tu 'grub pa'i phrin las rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ khyad par tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba'i sdig sgrib bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes 'dod don gsol/ klu chog ma grub na smon lam tshar ma thag par 'dir 'jug ste/

sāts+tsha rnams re re bzhin chu'i steng du bzhugs su gsol ba'i tshul gyis mgo mjug ma ldog par bzhag la/ gzungs sngags tshar re'i mjug tu/ tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba'i dge ba'i rtsa bar gyur cig /'di kho nas ngan song gsum gyi gnas las thar te bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten dang dag pa'i zhing khams rnams su skye bar gyur cig /mthar thug rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig /ces ci nus brjod/ yid kyis rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku rdul phra rab tu gyur te klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis rgya mtsho chen por mchod pa'i yo byad dang bcas te spyan drangs pa'i tshe/ rgya mtsho' 'gram du gnas pa'i drang srong bden tshig grub pa rnams kyis kyang mngon par shes pas dgongs te smon lam gyi mthun 'gyur mdzad pa/ sa bla'i lhas 'og min gyi bar du rjes su bsgrags shing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas kyang bden tshig gis mtshams sbyar bar bsam/ las grub pa dang*/ de dag gi mthu la brten nas tshe 'das nyid ngan song las grol te mtho ris su skyes shing lus kyang ston nas sangs rgyas kyi phrin las la ched du brjod pa/ e ma'o sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyang*// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces brjod nas mi snang bar bsams la klu chog yod na gshegs/ gang ltar yang bsngo smon dang shis pa rgyas par brjod pas dge legs su bya/ bdag bskyed bsdu/ mchod pa'i yo byad dman ma rnams chu bor dor la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// tshwa khang spros pas mi lcogs ba dang phal pa rnams la 'di kho na ltar legs shing*/ 'di nyid gzungs mdo'i dgongs pa dmigs bsal yin pas sāts+tsha yin tshad chur gshegs rung ba ma yin no// gang zag bzang po yin kyang 'di ltar 'grub na thugs dgongs rdzogs byed du 'gyur ba las nyes pa'i cha phra mo'ang med pas/

de ltar na/ smon lam gyi skabs su dge ba'i bshes gnyen che ge mo'i de'i thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can rdzogs par gyur cig /de nyid kyi 'brel thogs kyi 'gro ba thams cad ngan song gsum gyi gnas las thar te sogs bsgyur bar bya'o// gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ sāts+tsha rnams rab gnas grub pa dang lam gyi bzhi mdor mchod rten brtsigs pa'i nang du legs par bsgrigs pa'i bar du bye mas bcer/ de'ang tshad la nges pa med de 'byor pa dang bstun/ dbyibs la nges pa med de gang 'dod bya/ mthong tshad reg tshad kyi sgrib pa 'dags pa'i rgyu yin gsungs kyang deng sang tshwa khang du grags pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten nyid bya sla la legs par mngon/ de la'ang dri med cho gas srog shing 'dzug chog grub na phan yon lhag par che/ bzhugs su gsol grub nas/ chur gshegs skabs ltar sa gzhi byin rlabs nas smon lam tshigs lhug gi bar du bya/ klu chog mi dgos/ rnam snang gi rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin mchod rten gyi phung po las 'od zer 'phro bas mthong thos dran reg sangs rgyas kyi sar sgrol ba'i phrin las rtag tu mdzad par mos la rten snying gi me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ srung ma la gtor ma 'bul te mchod rten gyi gnyer du gtad/ snga phyi gnyis ka gang byed kyang de'i nyin mo bzhi sder longs pa yan chod kyi dge 'dun la ci 'byor ba'i chos ston gsol te smon lam rgya chen po gdab tu gzhug go /gzhan yang pad+ma dang seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa'i mi 'khrugs pa'i sku tshon gyis 'bri ba'am/ sa las byas pa'ang rung ste stong phrag gcig bzhengs nas smon lam gdab na mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar nges pa mdo las gsungs pa'ang bya sla la don chen por snang bas zhar byung du smos pa'o// ༈ //lto dang grags pa sgrub pa'i yang zong gis// don chung mdzes khrigs tsam la blo rtse gtad// rgyal bas gsung rnams sla yang mi byed pa// deng sang phal cher thub pa'i gdung
